evidence_against.relevance: Casey consistently initiated contact and arranged approximately weekly one-on-one time over twelve weeks.
Casey invested time in helping Drew with an important interview and attended a birthday dinner Drew identified as important.
Casey independently resumed regular contact after two periods of geographic separation.

evidence_supporting.relevance: Casey twice declined to define the relationship and offered no timeline for revisiting the issue, supporting a low-commitment interpretation.
Meetings were usually convenient for Casey or arranged at short notice, and Casey canceled advance plans when other commitments arose.
Casey has not integrated Drew into close social or family circles and declined a future event because it required planning two months ahead.

recommended_action.explanation: Drew could ask directly whether Casey expects the involvement to remain undefined and short-term or is willing to discuss a clearer direction and timeframe.

uncertainty_explanation: Casey's sustained initiation, practical support, and resumed contact show genuine interest and effort, but the repeated avoidance of definition, limited advance planning, convenience-centered meetings, cancellations, and lack of social integration more strongly support low-commitment involvement than meaningful commitment.
